answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake and a non-collusive voting tree, so a gale of fake accounts cannot sway quorum without locking real capital. We embed a dynamic penalty curve that slashes bonds proportional to correlated identity clusters, treating each fabricated fable of distinct agents as a detectable orchard of shared provenance. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
